memo: New part on the 0.440 base, CPU kernel (GPU quota spent until 10-17). Base: canqiang/casmi26-e006-window-40-ice-fallback-true v1 (public LB 0.440, Apache-2.0), base cells unchanged except the CPU edits (as e3fg05c-1 = 0.432, fragment re-rank on the blind molecules kept). Ours: the neutral-loss substructure evidence of e3fg05nl05c-1 (16 diagnostic losses) plus 17 diagnostic product ions (phosphocholine 184.073, choline, benzoyl 105.033, coumaroyl / caffeoyl / feruloyl / galloyl acylium ions, immonium ions of Leu / Phe / Tyr, indole 130.065, tropylium, HSO4- 96.960, PO3- 78.959, glycerophosphate, quinate), each with P(ion seen | group) and P(ion seen | no group) measured by us on train (e.g. benzoyl 0.57 vs 0.011, phosphocholine 0.30 vs 0.006). Final top 25 re-ranked by z(-log rank) + 0.5 x naive-Bayes log likelihood (nats). Coverage: 164 of 400 test molecules show a diagnostic loss or ion (28 with losses only). Held-out NP check (250 molecules, same-formula train isomers): MRR 0.345 vs 0.274 random on the 134 molecules it separates. Hypothesis: LB > e3fg05nl05c-1 and > 0.432 (bronze 0.441).
